passive.name: Fired Up!
passive.description: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

spells.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
spells.description: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.
spells.tooltip:
Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by {{ slowamountpercent }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Hitting at least one enemy champion with Ultra Mega Fire Kick refunds {{ refundratio*100 }}% of it's Mana cost.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Cozy Campfire
spells.description: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.
spells.tooltip:
Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for {{ zoneduration }} seconds. Ally champions nearby gain {{ rangepercent }} Attack Range and restore {{ healingovertime }} Health over the duration. The hearth also applies Fired Up! every {{ healfrequencyseconds }} seconds.

Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Warm Hugs
spells.description: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.
spells.tooltip:
Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting {{ shieldcalc }} Shield and {{ movespeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ movespeedduration }} seconds.

This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.description: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.
spells.tooltip: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing <status>Disabling</status> and <status>Immobilizing</status> effects, restoring <healing>{{ healcalc }} Health</healing>, and granting {{ tenacityamount*100 }}% Tenacity for {{ tenacityduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Fired Up!
effects: Innate: Milio's ability hits on himself and allied champions grant an enchantment for 4 seconds, which causes the next basic attack or ability hit against enemies to deal 7% / 11% / 15% (based on level) of enchanted target's AD bonus magic damage and apply a burn that deals[ 10 : 50 (based on level) (+ 20% of Milio's AP) magic damage over 1.5 seconds. ][ 1.67 : 8.33 (based on level) (+ 3.33% of Milio's AP) magic damage every 0.25 seconds over 1.5 seconds. ]

variants.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
effects: Active: After a 0.25-second delay, Milio kicks a fireball in the target direction that grants sight of its path and knocks back and stuns the first enemy it hits over 1 second.

If the primary target is a non-champion, the ball knocks back further and creates a larger explosion. Ultra Mega Fire Kick refunds 50% of its mana cost if it hits at least one champion with the fireball or explosion.
Milio cannot cast other abilities during Ultra Mega Fire Kick's delay.

variants.name: Cozy Campfire
effects: Cozy Campfire can be recast after 0.5 seconds within the duration.
Recast: Milio commands the fuemigo to follow the target allied champion to within 150-units, placing the recast on a 0.5-second static cooldown.
Milio counts as an allied champion for this ability. Cozy Campfire may grant Fired Up! upon being summoned and at most once every 3 seconds thereafter.

variants.name: Warm Hugs
effects: Milio periodically stocks a Warm Hugs charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Warm Hugs' effects can stack up to 2 times.

variants.name: Breath of Life
effects: Milio cannot cast his other abilities for 0.75 seconds after Breath of Life's activation. Breath of Life cannot be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

changes.title: Passive - Fired Up!
changes.text: Damage : 15% of ally's AD, followed by 15-50 (based on level) (+20% of Milio's AP) burn damage over 1.5 seconds ⇒ 7/11/15% (levels 1/6/9) of ally's AD, followed by 10-50 (based on level) (+20% of Milio's AP) burn damage over 1.5 seconds

changes.title: Q - Ultra Mega Fire Kick
changes.text: NEW : Hitting at least one enemy champion with Ultra Mega Fire Kick refunds 50% of its mana cost.

changes.title: W - Cozy Campfire
changes.text: NEW : Cozy Campfire is slower when following targets that are more than 2500 units from Milio.

changes.title: Passive - Fired Up!
changes.text: On Fire : Burn damage now counts as Milio's damage even when applied through allies, allowing it to interact with a select number of items like Chemtech Putrifier. Burn damage will still grant the ally who applied the debuff the kill, preventing Milio from accidentally kill stealing confirming kills.

changes.title: Passive - Fired Up!
changes.text: Burn Damage : 25-80 (based on level) (+20% AP) ⇒ 15-50 (based on level) (+20% AP)

changes.title: Passive - Fired Up!
changes.text: Empowered Attack Damage : 15%-35% AD (based on ally's level) ⇒ 15% AD (based on ally's level)

attackDamageGrowth.method: Archived baseline with subsequent official stat changes applied
